thread:
maya: Heads-up — big customer asked for an exception: allow multiple small tiers to stack towards a committed slab for 12 months. They want near-infinite burst while still on mid-tier pricing. Need product/legal/finance alignment, quick.
ian: Can you paste the ask?
maya: Quote: 'We want tier A + addon B counts to sum into commit for overage forgiveness and priority lane for the first 12 months.' They want it in contract and in billing.
sam: That sounds like a credit/entitlement escrow. Finance concerns: revenue recognition, forecasting gets murky. We can do a deferred credit but need commit clarity.
alex: Implementation-wise, we can map additive SKUs to a virtual "commit bucket" at billing time. Requires changes to metering and Console UI to show effective commit usage. Low-medium scope.
claudia: Legal: adding stacking semantics changes our liability profile. Need explicit cap on stacking, an end date, and escape clause for capacity constraints. Also want audit trail for how credits applied.
maya: Suggested approach: 1) Pilot with one customer using a 'stacking addendum' for 12mo 2) Expose an entitlement flag (stacking=true) 3) Render on invoice and in Console. Thoughts? :thinking:
ian: Technically ok. Key perf implication: priority lane routing must respect new bucket without bypassing isolation rules. If they want "near-infinite burst" we should gate by capacity tier and fallback models.
sam: For pilot, finance can sign off if we require a non-refundable activation fee and cap the total stackable amount to N tokens/month. Without that, forecasting variance is too high.
claudia: Agreed on cap + activation fee. Also include a KPI-triggered rollback: if stack usage > X% of Dedicated pool for Y days, we can throttle. Need explicit SLA changes.
maya: Acceptance criteria for launch pilot: - legal addendum signed - Console shows "Stacking entitlement" and commit bucket view - Invoice line-item for activation fee and monthly cap - Routing honors entitlement but respects capacity fallback - Observability: per-route cost+latency breakdown for stacked usage
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: license_addendum_template.md updated, billing-schema migration queued, metering-service feature-flag created (feature_flag:stacking_entitlement).
alex: UX note: show both raw SKU usage and effective commit usage. Keep it hidden unless you have entitlement. Small mock: 
```
CommitBucket: {
  commit_id: "C-2026-09",
  included_tokens: 30M,
  stackable_addons: ["addon-b", "addon-c"],
  stack_used: 4.2M
}
```
maya: Next steps: Sam/Claudia can we get signoff on cap + fee by EOD tomorrow? Ian/Alex scope estimate by Friday so Eng can schedule a two-week pilot sprint.
sam: I'll propose numbers: activation fee = $20k, monthly stack cap = 10M tokens for pilot. Send to finance-ops.
claudia: I'll draft a short addendum, with explicit termination and rollback clauses. Will ping legal-review.
ian: I'll scope prioritization: meter + UI + routing checks ~= 6 dev-days. Need an oncall buffer for rollout.
maya: Thanks all — will collate decisions into a short PRD and attach to the addendum thread. :thumbsup:
